51x8:
If students can deal with day-to-day problems and remain calm in the face of a crisis, they might have what it takes to work in the field of risk and crisis management.

Risk management is a crucial part of running a business, and University of Portsmouth's MSc Risk, Crisis and Resilience Management degree course will take students' aptitude and mould it into expertise – so they'll be ready to steer organizations through critical situations as a risk manager, ensuring both their success and the students.

In this course, students will learn how to identify, assess and manage strategic, organizational, environmental and technological risks, as well as threats presented by unpredictable situations.

They'll get the knowledge and skills needed to become a proficient and capable risk manager, honing analytical and problem-solving abilities that are highly valued by employers.
51xd:
If students are looking for a Master's that'll sharpen their knowledge of economics and finance and give them a deep insight into the financial services sector, this is the postgraduate course for them.

In this MSc Economics, Finance and Banking degree course, students will focus on business decision-making and strategy. They'll learn to interpret trends, identify market risks and assess public policy, while developing the forecasting techniques that'll make them a real asset to the financial services and banking sectors.

When students graduate, their Master's degree can open doors to ambitious roles in the finance and banking sectors, business and commerce, industry, and private and public sectors.
51xe:
If students are ready to climb the ladder in the competitive world of finance, this MSc Finance degree course is the perfect way to build on their previous studies and experience, and develop the skills they need to achieve their career ambitions.

In this course, students will unpack the three major themes in finance: investments, corporate finance, and financial markets and institutions. They'll focus on financial investments, get their hands on University of Portsmouth's Bloomberg Suite and learn from experts in the industry.

When students graduate, they'll have the analytical tools they need to understand the complexities of modern financial markets – so they'll be ready to pursue a career as a city professional, or as a financial manager in a non-financial organization.
51zf:
Quantity surveying is an important business asset – sound professional advice in the area is essential in a number of industries, from construction to law.

If students want to progress their career in this highly sought-after field, this MSc Quantity Surveying course will give them the expertise and practical experience they'll need to succeed.

Students will develop their skill in efficient construction, law and the financial management of built environments. They'll get the knowledge and confidence required of professionals in the construction business – and follow in the footsteps of past graduates, many of whom now hold senior positions in the industry.
